WHAT SHIPPED (src/managent/main.zig + build.zig + tools/regression-run-record-scale.sh):
(1) readRunRecords is now bounded by the in-progress set. It takes the live tids, reproduces
tools/runner's _sanitize_identity filename mangling, and only opens files named <tid>.json or
<tid>.<N>.json for one of those tids. classifyReapRows collects the in-progress tids first and
passes them, so reap AND resume (the fleet-stalls surface) both inherit the bound. An
opt-in diagnostic MANAGENT_RUN_RECORD_OPENS=1 emits 'run-records: opened N of M .json entries for
K in-progress row(s)' so the bound is a number, not an assertion.
(2) New `managent archive-runs [--dry-run] [--date YYYY-MM-DD] [--min-age-days d]` (named
archive-runs, NOT archive — archive is the kanban retire command). A record is COLD when
(a) its task is not an in_progress row (or is no row), (b) its pid is dead per the process table
(a done row with a live worker — T909 — is never archived), and (c) it is older than
--min-age-days (default 2, so AC7's 24h wall-kill window and recent forensics are never hidden).
Cold records move into untracked/runs/archive-<date>/ via renamePreserve (atomic, non-replacing —
a destination collision leaves the source in place, never overwrites). Archive, never delete;
a re-dispatch writes a fresh bare record so the bare record stays findable.
